tasks.title: status adopts the fixed contract client and documents API response requirements
tasks.spec: ## Repository: status, all Behavior and Completion evidence; shared merged-contract finding in probe; Disclosure rule; Scope verification; Performance impact; Security impact; Rollout order; Acceptance evidence items 4-6

acceptance.expected: Before the first edit, record the full implementation-base SHA in task evidence; retain this BASE for every scope and performance check.

Create this disposable Git fixture script outside every repository and prove the five checks in plan.md, Scope verification, before relying on them. Record each check separately in all seven states: clean control: checks 1-5 pass, check 1 empty; allowed committed: check 1 allowed singleton, checks 2-5 pass; protected unstaged: checks 3,4 detect, checks 1,2,5 pass; protected staged: checks 2,4 detect, checks 1,3,5 pass; protected staged then worktree restored to base: git diff "$BASE" empty but checks 2,3,4 detect; protected committed with clean index/worktree: check 1 protected path, check 5 exit 1, checks 2-4 pass; protected committed then worktree restored to base: git diff "$BASE" empty but checks 1,3,4,5 detect, check 2 passes. Use an allowed file and a protected file, verify exact-path rejection against this task’s lists, and delete fixture/script afterwards.

After contract merges, read the shared finding of its full merged main SHA containing #864 and version 2.5.2; the first consumer records it and the other consumers reuse exactly that SHA. package.json and bun.lock pin that SHA together. No other dependency changes; request a hold if adoption needs any path outside this task's allowed list.
Exactly 1	1	package.json; the only changed line is the contract dependency pin.
Exactly 2	2	bun.lock; every added/deleted line contains pulse-contract, limited to the workspace dependency and package entry.
The contract SHA equals the independently recorded merged-contract shared finding; every other dependency and package field is unchanged.

0 failed tests. Location: real createStatusServer proxy path (fetchRaw, src/server.ts:405-430) and startApiPoll (src/api-poll.ts:24), native fetch. Class: redirect following. Proxy read of a redirecting api is not followed → received 3xx status, body {"error":"API error"}, no location header and destination count 0. Readiness poll counts a redirecting api as an error → outcome error and destination count 0. Local-only runtime test code chooses all construction; no peer layout, routing or response sequencing is prescribed or reported.

acceptance.command: Run src/server.upstream-redirect.test.ts with the base pin, then restore the merged pin and lockfile
acceptance.expected: The new adoption tests fail with the base pin (proxy serves destination data with 200) and pass with the fixed pin; report titles and outcomes only.
0 failed tests; every module imported by the merged contract dist graph is already served by the protected allowlist. If a module is missing, request a hold instead of changing src/server.ts.

Exit 0 under Bun 1.4.0, including lint, both source/e2e typechecks and full 80% line coverage. Existing src/server.cache.test.ts mapping, src/settings-poll.test.ts guard and src/server.contract-modules.test.ts allowlist pass unchanged.

README.md states every API request follows no redirect; the server asks for and requires uncompressed responses, the browser poller relies on browser decoding inside the 5 MiB cap, and the version error is fixed text without the received wire header.

Against a local fake api, load the page once: checks render, /pulse-contract/client.js and /pulse-contract/version.js return 200. Report the startup command and result; stop the service and delete local fixtures afterwards.

Run three times on the recorded implementation base and three on the branch, on one machine under Bun 1.4.0. Record user + system seconds rounded to 0.01 s, each median and branch-minus-base delta; no means. Expected delta under +0.1 s; fallback required above +0.3 s.

acceptance.command: git clone https://github.com/lorenzh/pulse-api.git "$SCRATCH/pulse-api"; (cd "$SCRATCH/pulse-api" && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun bench/run.ts --a "$API_MAIN" --b "$API_MAIN" --others-ref main --b-ref "status=$TARGET_REF" --rounds 1)
acceptance.expected: Conditional fallback only after the primary threshold is exceeded. The harness runs from the scratch api checkout, never this consumer or contract repository. Record the full api main SHA as API_MAIN for both sides and the public fetchable candidate branch/SHA as TARGET_REF; Docker with Compose, git and network required. Report status's rows and compare to api/bench/budgets.json using the plan's budget/floor rule; no api metric is expected to move. Delete the scratch checkout afterwards. Do not use --b-ref console.

acceptance.command: Review candidate security checklist and preserved consumer guards
acceptance.expected: Proxy error mapping, settings redirect guards, browser allowlist and production source stay unchanged. New API-read checks demonstrate redirect refusal, browser uses its streaming decoder, and pin matches merged contract finding. Public evidence follows the disclosure rule.

acceptance.command: Review task acceptance evidence and PR text against plan.md, Disclosure rule and Security impact
acceptance.expected: Public P2 security disclosure: findings security-contract-2026-11-03-1, -3, -4 and -5 name location, class, impact and fix direction only. Every security case in tasks, acceptance evidence and PR text is limited to title, class, expected outcome and budget. No working payload, fixture setup, server layout, routing, response order, header value, body content, encoder setting, response-construction steps or parameters, reproduction command, redirect recipe or oversized-response recipe. Test code alone chooses construction and builds hostile inputs at runtime. Audit all Counterexamples, including small compressed bodies, multi-coding header value, non-canonical identity spelling, precedence, body/header-text disclosure and Node/browser compatibility, against the current wording; no old fixture instructions survive. No new runtime or dev dependency, setting, exported name, result shape or wire version; timeout/abort behavior, default 5 MiB cap and caller maxBytes preserved.

Name #864 and inherited shared-client finding locations/classes/impacts/fix directions without inputs; report merged SHA, required checks, adoption red/green titles, documentation changes, performance medians and five separate scope outputs with fixture proof. Request a hold if any file outside this exact allowed list needs changing.
